algorithm: Seeded synthetic data generation, aggregation rollups, Markdown rendering
complexity: O(n) to generate and summarize n records
data_flow_ascii:
seeded RNG -> generate_records -> list of measurement dicts
records -> summarize -> totals, per-service rollups, error rate
summary + sample rows -> render_markdown -> demo_output/report.md
description_sentence: A report generator that builds seeded synthetic data, aggregates it, and writes a Markdown report with summary and per-service tables.
failure_note: No external input is parsed, so there is nothing malformed to handle; write errors propagate as normal OSErrors.

functions.desc: Build n seeded synthetic measurement records for the demo.
functions.name: generate_records

functions.desc: Aggregate totals, per-service rollups, error rate, and latency peaks.
functions.name: summarize

functions.desc: Render the summary and sample rows as a Markdown document.
functions.name: render_markdown
functions.signature: render_markdown(title: str, summary: dict, records: list) -> str

functions.desc: Write the Markdown report, creating parent folders; return the path.
functions.name: write_report

functions.desc: Generate data, summarize it, write the report, print a summary.
functions.name: run_demo
functions.signature: run_demo(seed: int, n_rows: int, out_path: str) -> int

functions.desc: Build the command-line parser for the demo.
functions.name: build_parser

functions.desc: Parse flags and run the report demo.
functions.name: main

label: report generator
output_shape: Prints aggregate stats to stdout and writes a Markdown report with summary, per-service, and sample-row tables.
pitch_sentence: I built a {topic} that turns raw measurements into a readable Markdown report with summaries you can actually act on.

qa.a: summarize() rolls up requests, errors, and max p99 latency per service, plus overall totals and the error rate.
A seeded RNG produces the same dataset on every run, so the report is reproducible byte-for-byte for a given seed.
The generator hardcodes a small service list and date window; a real version would read from logs or a database.
qa.q: What would change for production data?

resume_bullet_template: Built a {topic} in Python that aggregates seeded measurement data into summary tables and emits a Markdown report.
run_notes: --rows sets the record count; --out sets the report path (default ./demo_output/report.md); --title sets the heading.
scaling_note: Holds all records in memory; millions of rows would want streaming aggregation instead.
storage_note: Writes one Markdown file under ./demo_output; nothing else is persisted.
tradeoff_note: Hand-rolled Markdown keeps the demo dependency-free; a real reporting tool might use a templating engine.
